patch_resolves_note: The official fix patch applied to the vulnerable source, but the fixed-side incremental rebuild failed in the patched workspace because the fallback /bin/arvo compile path could not run configured test binaries there. Stage 04 therefore used compile-fixed --fallback-image, which rebuilt the instrumented target inside the authoritative n132/arvo:10724-fix image. That clean fixed run still reached guard_read and satisfied the required operand-selection obligation, so the repair evidence is genuine even though the incremental fixed build path was unavailable.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First non-harness project statement that consumes attacker-controlled input. It stores the fuzzer-supplied byte pointer into library state, which later backs all font-table reads through the face and font on the crashing path.

The loop is indexed by local `idx`, but the guard dereferences `buffer->cur()`, which uses the persistent buffer cursor instead of the loop index. Because GSUB left `buffer->idx == buffer->len` and `clear_positions()` did not reset it, the guard reads `info[len].mask` from uninitialized tail storage. The patch fixes this by reading `info[idx].mask`.

MSan crash site. The fallback-kern guard reads `info[buffer->idx].mask` through `buffer->cur()` instead of `info[idx].mask`; with the preserved stale cursor at `buffer->len`, this tests the first uninitialized tail slot in the `info` allocation.
clear_positions() zeroes positions but leaves the buffer cursor untouched, so the stale cursor value entering positioning remains equal to the active glyph count.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records positions_cleared.cursor_idx=19 and positions_cleared.active_glyph_count=19.

edges.description: The same stale buffer cursor value preserved by clear_positions() reaches the fallback-kern guard unchanged and is the selector used by the vulnerable guard operand.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace carries cursor_idx=19 from positions_cleared directly into the first guard_read event.
